answer: Duplicating identities costs a fresh bond per fake agent, and slashing burns the entire stake on proven collusion, so manufacturing influence scales linearly with real capital at risk rather than free aliases. Sybil resistance here uses a staked identity bridge: each agent locks a bond in the grove registry prior to voting, and every attestation requires a signed ivory-key proof tied to that stake. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
